fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Veterinary Officer Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the exam date for the recruitment of Medical Officer & Various Group A and Group B posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 2158 posts. Applications for the UPPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 22 December 2025, to 22 January 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 03 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPPSC Veterinary Officer Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 December 2025
  • Last Date : 22 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 January 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 29 January 2026
  • Exam Date : 03 October 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 105/-
  • SC, ST, ESM Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs.25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
